spanish: Y tú, alza tu vara y extiende tu mano sobre el mar y rájalo, y entren hijos de Israel en medio del mar en la seca.

findings.issue: בַּיַּבָּשָׁה is a definite noun (dry land/ground). «la seca» keeps only the quality dry, or shifts to drought, and omits that noun.

notes: The rest matches the 2ms commands, the 3ms split of the sea, and the 3mp coming of the sons of Israel into the midst of the sea.
